BackendUrl.title: Handoff server origin
BackendUrl.description: HTTPS origin of the self-hosted backend, with no path. Read-only in device setup. No credentials belong here.

AutoRegister.title: Register this browser automatically
AutoRegister.description: Defaults to true when BackendUrl is configured. Creates a distinct local device identity. Secure device pairing is still required.

DeviceName.title: Initial browser name
DeviceName.description: Optional initial name for newly registered browsers. Users can rename their browser afterward. Omit for a unique generated name.
